_dependency_manifest: responsibility Exposes shared VS Code task entrypoints for AgentCanon validation commands.
upstream design ../documents/runtime/SHARED_RUNTIME_SURFACES.md shared runtime surface policy

tasks.label: AgentCanon: Docs Check
tasks.command:
if [ -x "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon/bin/agent-canon" ]; then
  AGENT_CANON_BIN="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon/bin/agent-canon"
else
  AGENT_CANON_BIN="${workspaceFolder}/tools/bin/agent-canon"
fi
"$AGENT_CANON_BIN" docs check

tasks.label: AgentCanon: Dependency Headers
tasks.command:
if [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon/agent_tools/check_dependency_headers.py" ]; then
  AGENT_CANON_TOOLS="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon/agent_tools"
else
  AGENT_CANON_TOOLS="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent_tools"
fi
python3 "${AGENT_CANON_TOOLS}/check_dependency_headers.py" --changed && bash "${AGENT_CANON_TOOLS}/scan_dependency_headers.sh" --changed --fail-missing && bash "${AGENT_CANON_TOOLS}/check_dependency_header_format.sh" --changed --require-header
